## Getting Started


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(spdep, tmap, ggstatsplot, tidyverse, knitr, GWmodel, sf)
```
:::


## Preparing the Data

### Importing Hunan shapefile


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sf <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "Hunan")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
Reading layer `Hunan' from data source 
  `D:\mengtingyu88\geospatial-coursework\Hands-on_Ex\Hands-on_Ex04\data\geospatial' 
  using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
Simple feature collection with 88 features and 7 fields
Geometry type: POLYGON
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 108.7831 ymin: 24.6342 xmax: 114.2544 ymax: 30.12812
Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
```


:::
:::


### Importing Hunan_2012 table


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```
:::


### Joining Hunan and Hunan_2012


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sf <- left_join(hunan_sf, hunan2012) %>%
  select(1:3, 7, 15, 16, 31, 32)
```
:::


## Mapping GDPPC


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
basemap <- tm_shape(hunan_sf) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_text("NAME_3", size = 0.5)

gdppc <- qtm(hunan_sf, "GDPPC") +
  tm_layout(legend.position = c("left", "bottom"))

tmap_arrange(basemap, gdppc, asp = 1, ncol = 2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex04_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


## Converting to SpatialPolygonDataFrame


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sp <- hunan_sf %>%
  as_Spatial()
```
:::


## Determining Adaptive Bandwidth

### Cross-validation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw_CV <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                data = hunan_sp,
                approach = "CV",
                adaptive = TRUE,
                kernel = "bisquare",
                longlat = T)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


:::


### AICc


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw_AIC <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                 data = hunan_sp,
                 approach = "AIC",
                 adaptive = TRUE,
                 kernel = "bisquare",
                 longlat = T)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 46 AICc value: 1920.469 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 36 AICc value: 1917.324 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 29 AICc value: 1916.661 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 26 AICc value: 1914.897 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 22 AICc value: 1914.045 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 22 AICc value: 1914.045 
```


:::
:::


## Computing Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
               vars = "GDPPC",
               bw = bw_AIC,
               kernel = "bisquare",
               quantile = TRUE,
               adaptive = TRUE,
               longlat = T)
```
:::


## Preparing the Output Data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF)
hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwstat_df)
```
:::


## Visualising Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Local Mean")) +
  tm_borders(col_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title("Distribution of Geographically Weighted Mean") +
  tm_layout(legend.position = c("left", "bottom"))
```
